status: Planning complete; implementation and parity certification not performed

assumptions.Scope: Full observed feature parity includes payroll, accounts, reminders, ticketing and tools. Retail pilot is an increment, not completion of the competitor parity goal.
assumptions.Platform: Retain Next.js/Prisma/PostgreSQL and existing auth/clinical/insurance code. Read installed Next guides before implementation; no generic rewrite or new framework is required.
assumptions.Stock costing: FEFO by batch for dispensing; FIFO acquisition layers within selected lot, immutable allocation cost. Display weighted cost of current holdings; report does not confuse it with historical COGS.
assumptions.Reservation: Reserve at queued handoff/cashier checkout and transfer approval, with configurable TTL; quote-only cart does not reserve indefinitely. Expiry and cancel release atomically.
assumptions.Medicine returns: Physical returns enter quarantine until permitted review; refund decision is independent. Generic retail immediate restock is not copied as default medicine behavior.
assumptions.Posting: Single consistent posting kernel writes documents, stock/ledger effects, audit and outbox together. No external provider calls inside replayable DB transactions.
assumptions.Tax/pricing: Explicit net/gross and inclusive/exclusive policy per configured price list; per-product tax treatment and dated version; official mapping review required.
assumptions.Payer identity: CustomerAccount is billing identity; Patient is care recipient. Preserve insurer claim ledger separately, preventing duplicate ordinary-customer debt.
assumptions.Branch scope: Organization owns shared drug/lot/supplier/account masters; branch/store/location partitions operations. Scope-aware joins and server authorization cover read/write/export/attachment.
assumptions.Parity evidence: Observed screen/input = evidence of available UI. Proposed state/transaction/schema = our implementation design. No claim that competitor DB tables or integration correctness were recovered.
assumptions.Deadline: No deadline/team size supplied. Size labels S/M/L/XL mean relative complexity, not weeks. Re-estimate after foundation spike; no invented launch date.
assumptions.Legal/provider rules: Exact KRA fiscal contracts, payroll calculations, clinical dispensing/returns rules and privacy obligations need current official/domain validation before production certification; no statute rates supplied here.

reportCatalogue.name: Stock movements

reportCatalogue.name: Product catalog

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Branch hierarchy and business identity
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: One organization owns multiple branches; every sale, receipt, order, payment and stock event records its branch; migrate current data to a default branch.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Stores, shelves and bins
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Each branch contains stores and locations; the same drug batch can have separate balances at multiple locations without duplicating the drug catalog.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Store rules and quarantine locations
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Define sellable, receiving, transit, returns and damaged locations; POS cannot allocate quarantined or non-sellable stock.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Branch and store access scope
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Assign permitted branches and stores to staff; enforce scope in server reads, writes, exports and background jobs; cross-branch access is explicitly authorized.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Batch-preserving internal transfers
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Dispatch from a source, track in transit, receive at destination; retain batch, expiry and cost; partial receipts and discrepancies remain visible.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Transfer approvals and reversal
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: A distinct authorized receiver confirms delivery; duplicate dispatch/receipt cannot move stock twice; reversals use linked movements instead of editing history.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Branch dashboards and consolidated reporting
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Owners see consolidated and branch-filtered sales, margins, debt, stock and collections; transfers do not inflate organization-wide stock or revenue.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Purchase, dispensing and stock unit conversion
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Buy a pack of 100, sell 6 tablets, and retain 94 base units; product-specific conversion factors drive receipt, sale, return and transfer math.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Decimal quantities and unit precision
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Precision rules permit fractional quantities only for supported units; rounding never creates unexplained stock differences.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Stocktake sessions and variance approval
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Start a count by branch/store, capture observed quantities, review variance and reasons, approve once, and retain counter/approver and before/after balances.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Printable and importable count sheets
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Export a count sheet, optionally hide expected counts, import results with row validation, and post only reviewed variances.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Physical, reserved and available stock
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Reserve stock for queued checkout and transfers with an expiry; available equals physical less reservations; release reservations on cancellation or timeout.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Concurrency-safe stock allocation
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Two simultaneous buyers of the last unit produce one successful allocation; use atomic availability checks or locking and idempotent finalization.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Stock movement explorer and audit viewer
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Filter movements by branch/store/batch/reason/operator/document and drill through to origin; retain adjustment history and export it with permission checks.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Batch recall, quarantine and disposal
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Quarantine specific batches, trace affected sales, document disposal and block allocations; preserve existing FEFO and expired-stock exclusion.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Per-location reorder levels and suggested POs
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Calculate demand and lead-time-based reorder suggestions per drug/location using usable stock; approved suggestions create draft POs.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Product tax classes and effective rates
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: A mixed basket distinguishes standard, zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope classes with effective dates and line-level snapshots; validate local tax mappings before release.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Wholesale, promotional and minimum price tiers
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Retain cash and insurance prices; add wholesale and promotional tiers plus a margin/price floor with authorized override and audit.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Product images and receipt aliases
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Attach a product image and short label/receipt alias without losing generic name, strength or dosage form.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Hierarchical categories
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Allow parent-child categories and descriptions; search and reporting include child categories without double-counting sales.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Structured brands and manufacturers
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Maintain reusable brand/manufacturer records and references with contacts and origin; migrate free-text values without losing data.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Inventory items and service behavior
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Support pharmacy sundries and defined services; services do not consume drug stock, while tracked medicines retain required batch/expiry controls.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Validated CSV catalog import
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Preview mappings and errors, detect duplicates, choose create/update behavior, and import valid rows atomically or with a clear per-row result.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Supplier financial terms and opening balances
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Record contact person, tax identifier where needed, terms, credit limits and opening balance with audit; calculate overdue balances consistently.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Purchase-order drafting and approval
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Create supplier/branch/store POs with quantities, units, costs, tax, discounts, freight and expected delivery; move draft to approved with permission checks.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Partial receiving against purchase orders
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Receive less than ordered, retain outstanding quantities, and prevent over-receipt unless explicitly authorized; show draft, approved, partial, received and cancelled states.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Goods received notes and batch capture
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Capture actual quantities, lots, expiry and storage locations on a GRN; commit once to stock after review and link it to the PO.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Direct supplier invoice receipt
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Receive multiple drugs/batches directly from an invoice without a PO; one commit updates stock and supplier liability with a shared reference.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: PO–GRN–invoice matching
originalBacklogTraceability.competitor: Document links observed; matching controls proposed
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Flag quantity, price and tax discrepancies across ordered, received and billed items; do not pay a disputed document without an explicit override.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Supplier returns and credit allocation
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Return accepted quantities against original receipt batches, remove appropriate stock, record reason and credit, and allocate the credit against supplier bills.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Supplier statements and aging
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Opening debt plus invoices minus credits/payments equals closing debt; show due/overdue buckets and printable supplier statements.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Register opening, cash float and day close
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Open a cashier/register session with float; close with counted cash, expected cash, payments by channel, variance and supervisor approval.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Customer credit invoices and payment terms
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Permit an authorized credit sale with due date and customer limit; support partial settlement, outstanding amount and overdue status separately from insurance claims.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Customer debt settlement and statements
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Allocate payments to invoices, prevent duplicate receipts and show opening balance, invoices, credits, settlements and closing balance.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Quotations and conversion
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Prepare a quote with validity, quantities and terms; track pending/sent/accepted/rejected; convert once with a fresh stock and price check.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Partial sales returns and refund approvals
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Return only unreturned sold quantities, approve a refund, link payment reversal/credit and batch disposition, and never automatically restock unsafe returned medicines.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Sale voids and controlled corrections
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Void with reason and permission before dispatch where appropriate; corrections after completion use linked reversal/credit documents and preserve financial history.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Cashier UI for split tender
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: A cashier splits one invoice across supported channels; pending versus confirmed payments and any insurance portion remain explicit; balance reconciles to total.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Additional payment channels
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Record card, bank transfer and Airtel Money with traceable references and reconciliation states; treat recorded tender separately from a certified gateway integration.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Quick-sale shortcuts and counter efficiency
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Preserve keyboard search/Enter selection; add clear checkout shortcuts, focus return and rapid repeat scanning; measure completion time using representative tasks.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Delivery charges and invoice remarks
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Record delivery/handling as explicit sale lines and notes, with correct totals and tax mapping; print a delivery document where needed.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Loyalty points ledger and redemption
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Earn/redeem through a traceable ledger, configure point value and expiry, reverse points on returns, and never confuse discounts with point balances.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Corporate accounts and account status
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Represent individual versus corporate payer accounts, account status, terms and optional billing identifiers while keeping patient clinical identity distinct.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: SMS/email gateway and delivery history
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Configure tenant-scoped credentials safely; preview recipient selection and templates, queue delivery, record success/failure and enforce consent/preferences.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Overdue balance reminders
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Filter due and overdue invoices, preview SMS/email reminders, log sending and suppress settled accounts or opted-out recipients.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Prescription refill reminders
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Use refillDueAt to queue consent-aware reminders with quiet hours, deduplication, delivery status and patient-facing pharmacy contact information.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Immutable transaction-time cost snapshots
originalBacklogTraceability.competitor: Unit cost shown; historical immutability unverified
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Snapshot cost on each batch allocation; changing a batch cost later must not rewrite previously earned gross margin.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Revenue, tax and COGS correctness
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Gross profit equals net sales excluding tax minus historical COGS after discounts and returns; collection of old debt does not count as new sales revenue.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Double-entry ledger and chart of accounts
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Post balanced, linked journal entries for sales, receipts, returns, stock and expenses; retain reversal history and make journal totals traceable.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Trial balance, balance sheet and income statement
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Generate statements from the same ledger and period rules; debit equals credit and assets equal liabilities plus equity; expose unresolved opening-balance differences.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Cash, bank and M-Pesa reconciliation
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Match each settlement to a payment exactly once; retain unmatched items, fees and variance; branch/register collection totals tie to the payment ledger.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Configurable expenses and other income
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Add user-defined categories, payment source, branch, attachments and approval; keep sales-derived income separate from manually entered other income.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Financial exports and report catalogue
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Offer permission-scoped CSV/Excel and print outputs for sales, payments, aging, stock, returns and branch summaries with consistent filters and totals.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Granular configurable permissions
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Separate cashier, pharmacist, branch manager, purchaser, accountant and owner privileges; require specific grants for price overrides, refunds, stock changes and exports.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Approval queues and actionable exceptions
originalBacklogTraceability.competitor: Returns/GRN approval UI; unified queue proposed
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Show pending transfers, GRNs, returns, large discounts and reconciliation variances with ownership, age, review evidence and decision audit.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Staff directory and payroll profiles
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Maintain employee records linked to user and branch, salary details and employment state; payroll access is separately restricted.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Payroll allowances, deductions and advances
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Version allowance/deduction rules by period, track advance balances and repayment; validate applicable Kenyan payroll rules before production use.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Payroll runs, payslips and payment ledger
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Approve one payroll per period, produce payslips and exports, record partial disbursements and outstanding amounts, and prevent duplicate runs/payments.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Internal support tickets
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Create ticket with assignee, priority, attachment and threaded history; show pending items and permissions without sending messages automatically.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Correct M-Pesa callback and confirmation lifecycle
originalBacklogTraceability.competitor: Configuration UI only; gateway not validated
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: A failed callback remains failed; success extracts and verifies amount/receipt and updates the linked Payment atomically; duplicate callbacks are harmless.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Tenant/branch-specific gateway configuration
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Scope business numbers and secure credential references to the owning tenant/branch; use the chosen environment in actual requests; never expose secrets in UI responses.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: eTIMS submission and credit-note lifecycle

originalBacklogTraceability.title: True offline selling and safe synchronization
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Persist supported transactions locally, show pending sync, deduplicate on reconnect and resolve stock conflicts; define supported tenders and protect data on logout/device loss.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Safe retries and document numbering
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Use idempotency keys and concurrency-safe document sequences per scope; retrying checkout, GRN or transfer cannot duplicate stock, payment or numbering effects.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Structured pharmacist review and clinical safety
originalBacklogTraceability.competitor: Prescription manager claimed; comparable workflow not observed

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Expiry loss prevention and branch redistribution
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Rank batches at risk by expiry, quantity, demand and value; suggest branch transfers or supplier returns with review before execution.

originalBacklogTraceability.title: Fast onboarding, migration and release proof
originalBacklogTraceability.competitor: Catalog import observed; wider migration proposed
originalBacklogTraceability.acceptance: Import opening batches, balances, suppliers and patients with a reconciliation report; validate critical workflows with two-branch acceptance scenarios and recovery drills.

postingMatrix.invariant: Paid/free quantities and applicable landed-cost/tax rules reconcile; bill matching clears GRNI without adding stock twice.

postingMatrix.stock: Same receipt posting; paid and free units included
postingMatrix.financial: Dr inventory (+recoverable tax where applicable); Cr supplier payable
postingMatrix.invariant: One atomic convenience command, two explicit linked events; tax/account mappings depend on validated treatment.

postingMatrix.financial: Dr GRNI/input tax/approved variance accounts; Cr payable
postingMatrix.invariant: Never post inventory twice simply because both GRN and bill screens exist.

postingMatrix.financial: No new revenue/expense; location/branch asset dimensions transfer or balanced clearing
postingMatrix.invariant: Company total preserved; discrepancy/write-off is a separate approved posting.

postingMatrix.stock: Consume original FEFO allocations and reservations
postingMatrix.financial: Dr confirmed cash/settlement or AR; Cr net revenue + output tax; Dr COGS; Cr inventory
postingMatrix.invariant: Credit and insurance are receivables until collection; cost includes immutable allocation snapshots.

postingMatrix.financial: Dr confirmed cash/settlement; Cr account receivable
postingMatrix.invariant: Allocating one receipt to multiple invoices is not multiple money events.

postingMatrix.stock: Receive into disposition only if goods physically returned
postingMatrix.financial: Dr sales returns and tax reversal; Cr AR/refund payable; restore inventory/COGS only for reviewed recoverable value
postingMatrix.invariant: Damaged/quarantined value/impairment explicit; refund settlement separate from approval and restock.

postingMatrix.invariant: Failed refund attempt does not settle payable; exchange also posts a new linked sale.

postingMatrix.invariant: Accepted credit reduces payable/settles claim; physical dispatch alone is not assumed accepted credit.

postingMatrix.financial: Credit: Dr payable; Cr return claim. Payment: Dr payable; Cr confirmed settlement
postingMatrix.invariant: Credit/payment allocations cannot exceed available credit/payment or bill residual.

postingMatrix.financial: Dr/Cr inventory and mapped loss/adjustment counterpart
postingMatrix.invariant: Reason, cost provenance, reviewer and original/reversal group retained.

postingMatrix.financial: Expense Dr mapped expense/payable; Cr settlement or payable. Income Dr settlement/receivable; Cr mapped other income
postingMatrix.invariant: Sales cannot also be manual other income; drawer effects linked once.

postingMatrix.financial: Dr wage expense; Cr salary/deduction payables. Advance issue Dr employee advance receivable; Cr settlement
postingMatrix.invariant: Verified rules define deductions and payees; repayment offsets advance receivable instead of creating new income.

postingMatrix.financial: Dr salary payable; Cr confirmed settlement
postingMatrix.invariant: Calculation and cash disbursement are separate events; partial confirmation leaves residual payable.

postingMatrix.stock: Normal sale allocation on redemption only

relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Unique branch/store/location codes by parent; default leaf; acyclic hierarchy; composite tenant-consistent refs.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: M:N through explicit grant and assignment joins
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Role assignment scope distinct from store location; revoke access invalidates sessions; clinical/payroll separate.
Lot identity shared; supplier and immutable cost at acquisition receipt layer; duplicate lot key policy explicit.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: M:N via StockLayerPosition; aggregate BatchLocationBalance is projection
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Unique layer/location/disposition; sum layer positions=aggregate; transaction updates single source of truth.
Exactly one typed operational source per group (sale, receipt, dispatch, receipt-of-transfer, adjustment, return etc); database CHECK plus tenant-consistent FKs, source uniqueness.
Allocation qty and unit cost immutable; links original lot, location and receipt layer; return uses original allocation.
Receipt line links dispatched allocation; conservation and partial totals checked under lock; aggregate received cannot exceed dispatched.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: M:N allocation joins at each boundary
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Quantity/unit/cost snapshots; one delivery/invoice can cover several source lines; bounds/three-way match transactional.
Money/credit amount and invoice residual bounded; explicit reversals rather than destructive edits.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: Optional M:N membership/payer association; Sale separately links both
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Billing contact is not necessarily care recipient; insurer claim not duplicated into customer AR.
Standalone receipt not hard-wired to one invoice; channel/attempt details retained; same account scope enforced.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: N:1 original line; M:N quantities through disposition allocations
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Returned+previous approved qty≤sold; financial credit/refund independent of actual returned stock.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: 1:N→1:N; Sale/receipt/refund/payout links session where it affects drawer
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Partial unique open-session key via database index; close cutoff; no duplicated cash ledger events.
Balances validated before posting; immutable/reversible; source group key; optional branch dimension with clearing.
Unique posted employee-period; frozen component/rule versions; advance repayment and salary balances derived.
Purpose/channel preferences; dedupe intent keys; delivery attempt records; ambiguous provider timeout reconciled.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: 1:N components, each N:1 item; SerialItem links cost layer/location and sold allocation
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Reject cycles; explode components once; service has no inventory; asset separate ledger account.
Private scoped parent ownership; no global public file IDs; retain timeline.

relationshipCatalogue.cardinality: Sequence unique tenant/branch/type/period; mutation unique tenant/op/client key
relationshipCatalogue.constraints: Atomic allocation and original command result; idempotency neither blocks unrelated ops nor duplicates external side effects.

defaultPolicies.inactiveRecords: retain existing history; reject new posting
defaultPolicies.reservationTTL: configured by owner; implementation initial 15 minutes with visible expiry and renewal
defaultPolicies.clinicalAccess: separate from store and payroll grants
defaultPolicies.payrollPosting: one posted employee-period; verified rule version
defaultPolicies.schemaTypeNotes: Cost layers store high-precision per-base-unit cost and rounded total acquisition cost; immutable allocations preserve total via deterministic residual handling.

deliverySemantics: DB events/outbox are atomically recorded and dispatched at least once. Local intent/event keys deduplicate business effects; providers use idempotency keys where supported. An ambiguous timeout without provider idempotency/status lookup is placed in reconciliation rather than blindly resent. Do not claim exactly-once external SMS/payment execution solely from a local outbox.
